ValidationRule.description: Cambia el campo a ser obligatorio para Shipments de tipo M, R, PTO, CE y FI.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( TRIM(Account_Shipment_Reference__c) ), OR( CONTAINS(UPPER( Name),"PTO"), CONTAINS(UPPER( Name),"R"), CONTAINS(UPPER( Name),"M"), CONTAINS(UPPER( Name),"CE"), CONTAINS(UPPER( Name),"FI") ), NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name,"Admin")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: El campo Customer Reference necesita llenarse con la informacion apropiada para continuar.
